content: अङ्गुलः [अङ्ग्-उल्] .²1 A finger. .²2 The thumb, अङ्गौ पाणौ लीयते ({%n.%} also). .²3 A fingerʼs breadth ({%n.%} also), equal to 8 barley-corns, 12 Aṅgulas making a वितस्ति or span, and 24 Aṅgulas a हस्त or cubit; शङ्कुर्दशाङ्गुलः <ls>Ms. 8. 271</ls>. .²4 (<ab>Astr.</ab>) A digit or 12th part. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the sage Chāṇakya or Vātsyāyana.
